en.headline: Japanese rock band Novelbright opens two-night Hong Kong stand at MacPherson Stadium…
en.dek: The Osaka group’s Asia Tour PYRAMID shows run on 25 and 26 August, with tickets from HK$699 and a VIP package including early entry and a photo opportunity.

zh.headline: 日本搖滾樂隊Novelbright今晚起麥花臣場館兩晚演出
zh.dek: 亞洲巡演「PYRAMID」於8月25及26日晚上7時舉行，門票由699港元起，另設VIP套票包括優先入場及合照機會。

en.headline: Two private cars collide inside Tate's Cairn Tunnel, one driver injured
en.dek: The early-morning crash on the northbound carriageway caused temporary congestion; one driver sustained minor injuries.

zh.headline: 大老山隧道兩私家車相撞 一司機輕傷
zh.dek: 今晨約3時北行線發生車禍，其中一輛車車頭嚴重損毀，隧道一度擠塞。

en.headline: Alisan Fine Arts opens Tradition Renewed ink exhibition in Central today
en.dek: The show marking the gallery’s 45th anniversary features four contemporary literati masters and runs until mid-November, with an opening reception this evening.

zh.headline: 藝倡畫廊今日開幕《傳統再造》水墨展
zh.dek: 畫廊45周年項目展出四位當代文人畫家作品，展期至11月中，今晚5時半至7時半舉行開幕酒會。

en.headline: Man arrested after parrot found with clipped wings and bloodstains in Tseung Kwan O
en.dek: A 39-year-old owner was detained on suspicion of cruelty to animals after a resident reported an injured bird near Po Lam Road North on Monday evening.

zh.headline: 將軍澳鸚鵡疑遭剪翼流血 39歲男主人涉虐畜被捕
zh.dek: 市民周一晚在寶琳北路發現受傷成鳥，翅膀羽毛被剪並帶血漬，警方拘捕姓張男主人，案件交將軍澳警區跟進。

en.headline: Parents arrested after 2-year-old left alone in Yuen Long village house
en.dek: A neighbour reported the toddler alone at a Kung Um Road address late on Monday; the child was found conscious with a swollen foot and taken to hospital.

zh.headline: 元朗2歲男童疑被獨留家中 父母涉虐兒被捕
zh.dek: 鄰居昨晚約10時報警指公庵路村屋有幼童獨留，警方到場發現男童清醒腳部紅腫，父母涉嫌對所看管兒童虐待或忽略被捕。

en.headline: Thunderstorm Warning in force until 8:30 am
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory issued the warning at 2:33 a.m. and later extended it, expecting isolated squally thunderstorms over the territory.

zh.headline: 雷暴警告生效至上午8時30分
zh.dek: 天文台於凌晨2時33分發出雷暴警告，其後延長至今早8時30分，預料本港有局部地區狂風雷暴。

en.headline: Free dental check-ups for kindergarten children start on 1 September
en.dek: The Department of Health’s new Outreach Oral Health Programme will send professional teams to schools for annual screenings and fluoride treatment; more than 70 per cent of kindergartens have already joined.

zh.headline: 學前兒童口腔健康外展計劃9月1日推出 七成幼稚園已參與
zh.dek: 衞生署新計劃將派出牙科團隊到校為幼稚園學童提供免費口腔檢查及預防服務，目前已有逾七成幼稚園報名。

en.headline: Consortium wins first Northern Metropolis large-scale land tender for HK$1.03 billion
en.dek: A six-company group including China Overseas, China Resources Land, Sino Land and JD.com will develop about 10.5 hectares in Hung Shui Kiu, providing around 3,000 flats and a smart logistics centre.

zh.headline: 北部都會區洪水橋大規模土地批出首標 財團以10.3億元中標
zh.dek: 由中海外、華潤置地、信和及京東等六企組成的財團投得約10.5公頃用地，將提供約3,000個住宅單位及智慧物流中心。

en.headline: Thunderstorm Warning issued for eastern waters until 9:30 pm
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory issued the warning at 8:15 p.m., expecting isolated thunderstorms over the eastern waters of Hong Kong.

zh.headline: 天文台發出雷暴警告至晚上9時半 預料東部水域局部有雷暴
zh.dek: 天文台晚上8時15分發出雷暴警告，有效至今晚9時30分，預料香港東部水域有局部地區雷暴。

en.headline: Sui and Tang civilisation exhibition at History Museum ends today
en.dek: The free Hong Kong Jockey Club Series show, featuring more than 165 sets of artefacts from Shaanxi and local finds, including 18 national first-class treasures, closes on Monday after a four-month run.

zh.headline: 歷史博物館隋唐文明展今日閉幕
zh.dek: 香港賽馬會呈獻系列「長安萬象——陝西隋唐文明展」免費展出逾165件（套）文物，包括18件國家一級文物，展期至今日結束。

en.headline: Half of public bodies omit greenhouse gas emissions data, green group finds
en.dek: The Green Earth’s study of 82 government departments and public entities showed 41 published emissions figures, while about eight used outdated emission factors that could overstate reductions.

zh.headline: 綠惜地球：半數公共機構未披露溫室氣體排放數據
zh.dek: 綠惜地球研究82個政府部門及公共機構，發現41個有公布排放數字，約八個使用過時排放因子，或令減排幅度被高估。

en.headline: Customs seize two live cats from mainland passenger at Lo Wu
en.dek: A 44-year-old man was arrested after officers found the animals, valued at about HK$2,000, in his luggage at the control point on Sunday; the case was referred to the Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department.

zh.headline: 海關羅湖截獲內地男旅客行李藏兩活貓
zh.dek: 44歲內地男旅客周日在羅湖管制站入境大堂被截查，行李內檢獲兩隻懷疑非法進口活貓，市值約2,000港元，男子當場被捕，案件交漁護署跟進。

en.headline: Chief Executive says Hong Kong is ideal launchpad for mainland firms going global
en.dek: John Lee told the Global Unicorn Summit that the city has nurtured around 20 local unicorns and offers comprehensive support through Science Park and Cyberport for startups expanding internationally.

zh.headline: 行政長官：香港是內地企業「走出去」的理想跳板
zh.dek: 李家超在全球獨角獸峰會表示，過去十年本港孕育約20家本地獨角獸企業，科學園及數碼港為初創提供全面支援。

en.headline: Alibaba prices HK$80 billion Hong Kong share placement to fund AI expansion
en.dek: The company is issuing 710 million new shares at HK$112.70 each, marking the largest primary follow-on offering by a Hong Kong-listed firm, with proceeds earmarked for full-stack AI capabilities.

zh.headline: 阿里巴巴港股配售800億港元新股 全部用於AI發展
zh.dek: 公司按每股112.70港元發行7.1億股新股，為港股歷來最大型一次主要後續發售，所得款項全數投入全棧人工智能能力。

en.headline: Government aims to make Smart Site Safety System standard on all construction sites
en.dek: Secretary for Development Bernadette Linn said accident rates fell about 20 per cent from 2023 to 2025 as adoption of the 4S system reached roughly 80 per cent of local sites.

zh.headline: 政府推動智慧工地安全系統成全港工地標準配置
zh.dek: 發展局局長甯漢豪表示，建造業意外率由2023至2025年下降約兩成，智慧工地安全系統已安裝於約八成本地工地。

en.headline: Very Hot Weather and Thunderstorm Warnings in force on Monday
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory issued the Very Hot Weather Warning at 10:45 a.m. and a Thunderstorm Warning at 11:18 a.m., valid until 1:30 p.m., expecting isolated thunderstorms over the eastern New Territories.

zh.headline: 酷熱天氣警告及雷暴警告生效 新界東部局部有雷暴
zh.dek: 天文台上午10時45分發出酷熱天氣警告，11時18分發出雷暴警告至下午1時30分，預料新界東部有局部地區雷暴。

en.headline: Mainland hotpot-ingredient chain Guoquan opens first Hong Kong store in Wan Chai
en.dek: The company, listed in Hong Kong, has opened its debut local outlet on Hennessy Road, describing the city as a testing ground for overseas expansion.

zh.headline: 內地火鍋食材連鎖鍋圈食匯灣仔開香港首店
zh.dek: 已於港上市的鍋圈食匯於軒尼詩道開設首間本地門店，形容香港是集團海外布局的試驗田。

en.headline: Shein launches Hong Kong IPO aiming for up to US$27 billion valuation
en.dek: The fast-fashion retailer is offering 280 million shares at HK$47.60 to HK$49.50 each, with pricing set for 31 August and trading expected to begin on 1 September.

zh.headline: Shein啟動港股上市 最高估值約270億美元
zh.dek: 快時尚零售商今起招股，發售2.8億股，每股定價介乎47.6至49.5港元，預計8月31日定價，9月1日開始買賣。

en.headline: Burglars take more than HK$200,000 from Sha Tin flat
en.dek: A 47-year-old woman returned to her Shui Chuen O Estate unit on Sunday night to find a window forced open and cash plus jewellery missing; police are investigating.

zh.headline: 沙田水泉澳邨單位遭爆竊 住戶失逾20萬現金珠寶
zh.dek: 47歲女住戶周日晚返回映泉樓單位，發現窗戶被撬及有搜掠痕跡，約7萬港元、5萬人民幣現金及8萬元珠寶金器失竊，警方列爆竊調查。

en.headline: Grammy-winning jazz vocalist Nicole Zuraitis returns to Xiqu Centre tonight
en.dek: The New York-based singer and her quartet perform two sets each evening on 24 and 25 August at the Tea House Theatre in West Kowloon.

zh.headline: 葛萊美得主Nicole Zuraitis今晚起戲曲中心茶館劇場演出
zh.dek: 紐約爵士歌手連同四重奏於8月24及25日每晚兩場在西九戲曲中心茶館劇場登台。

en.headline: Two 15-year-old boys arrested after red paint poured on Mong Kok watch shop
en.dek: An off-duty officer detained the pair early Monday after seeing them splash red paint on a shop signboard and pavement near Argyle Centre.

zh.headline: 旺角鐘錶舖遭淋紅油 兩名15歲男童當場被捕
zh.dek: 休班警員今晨在西洋菜南街近旺角中心發現兩名少年向鐘錶舖淋潑紅油，即場拘捕兩人。

en.headline: Elderly couple found dead at Kwai Chung Estate in suspected murder-suicide
en.dek: Police are investigating after an elderly man was found outside a residential block and a woman with multiple wounds was discovered inside their flat on Sunday night.

zh.headline: 葵涌邨春葵樓雙屍案 八旬翁墮樓 六旬婦伏屍單位內
zh.dek: 警方正調查一宗懷疑謀殺及自殺案，周日晚一名八旬男子倒臥大廈外，單位內發現一名六旬女子身上有多處利器傷痕。

en.headline: Design Ah! interactive exhibition continues at M+ through January
en.dek: The family-friendly show exploring everyday design through 21 play stations remains open at the Main Hall Gallery in West Kowloon until 10 January 2027.

zh.headline: M+《設計啊！》互動展持續至明年一月
zh.dek: 以日常設計為題的親子互動展覽於西九文化區M+主展廳舉行，設21個體驗站，展期至2027年1月10日。

en.headline: Hong Kong Computer & Communications Festival ends today at HKCEC
en.dek: The four-day tech fair focused on AI applications closes at 7 pm on Monday after drawing exhibitors and visitors to Hall 1 of the Convention and Exhibition Centre.

zh.headline: 香港電腦通訊節今日閉幕 會展開放至晚上七時
zh.dek: 以人工智能應用為主題的四日科技展覽今日最後一日於灣仔會展一號展覽廳舉行，晚上七時結束。

en.headline: Ethnic minority care teams have reached more than 18,000 households
en.dek: Chief Secretary Chan Kwok-ki said the teams, operating from ten support service centres, have delivered real impact through home visits and emergency support over the past two years.

zh.headline: 少數族裔關愛隊兩年多接觸逾1.8萬戶家庭
zh.dek: 政務司司長陳國基表示，關愛隊由十間支援服務中心營運，透過家訪及緊急支援發揮實質作用。

en.headline: Fifteen senior civil servants to begin year-long study at Peking University
en.dek: Secretary for the Civil Service Ingrid Yeung said the fifth cohort of the two-year Master of Public Administration programme will start immersive learning in Beijing next month.

zh.headline: 15名高級公務員下月赴北大展開一年沉浸式學習
zh.dek: 公務員事務局局長楊何蓓茵表示，第五屆高級公務員公共管理碩士課程學員將於九月在北京大學展開全年學習。

en.headline: Observatory monitors Tropical Storm Narra for possible signals midweek
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory said Narra is expected to linger over Beibu Wan before turning northeast towards the Leizhou Peninsula, with an assessment of tropical cyclone warning signals on Tuesday or Wednesday.

zh.headline: 天文台密切監察熱帶風暴紫檀 周二或周三或發熱帶氣旋警告
zh.dek: 天文台表示紫檀預料於北部灣徘徊後轉向東北靠近雷州半島，會評估周二或周三是否需要發出熱帶氣旋警告信號。

en.headline: More than 7,500 apply for combined taxi and ride-hailing written test
en.dek: Transport Secretary Mable Chan said the new exam, open since 3 August, has drawn strong interest and that platforms will be invited to apply for licences in the coming weeks.

zh.headline: 的士及網約車綜合筆試逾7500人報考 未來數周邀平台申請牌照
zh.dek: 運輸及物流局長陳美寶表示，綜合筆試自本月3日開放申請以來已有逾7500人報名，未來數星期會邀請網約車平台申請牌照。

en.headline: HKU wins ABU Robocon 2026 as both local teams reach final
en.dek: The University of Hong Kong team defeated the Chinese University of Hong Kong 240-100 in the final of the Asia-Pacific Broadcasting Union robotics contest held at Queen Elizabeth Stadium.

zh.headline: 亞太廣播聯盟機械人大賽港大奪冠 中大屈居亞軍
zh.dek: 亞太廣播聯盟機械人大賽周日於伊利沙伯體育館舉行，港大「格物」隊決賽以240比100擊敗中大「功無不克」隊奪冠。

en.headline: Two men injured after escalator fall at Shek Lei Shopping Centre
en.dek: A 76-year-old man lost his balance on a Phase 1 escalator on Sunday afternoon, colliding with a 68-year-old man behind him; both were taken to hospital conscious.

zh.headline: 石籬商場扶手電梯兩男跌倒受傷 七旬翁一度被困
zh.dek: 周日下午一名76歲男子在石籬商場一期扶手電梯失平衡向後跌，撞倒身後68歲男子，兩人清醒送瑪嘉烈醫院。

en.headline: Isaac Chong Wai’s first solo live-art show at Tai Kwun ends today
en.dek: The Berlin-based Hong Kong artist’s exhibition of conceptual performances exploring collective memory and vulnerability closes on Sunday after a run at Tai Kwun Contemporary.

zh.headline: 張子謙首個本地現場藝術個展大館今日結束
zh.dek: 駐柏林香港藝術家張子謙於大館當代美術館的概念表演展今日閉幕，探討集體記憶與脆弱性。

en.headline: Patient arrested after bedding and restraint belts set ablaze at Kwong Wah Hospital
en.dek: A 25-year-old man was arrested on suspicion of arson after a fire broke out at the Yau Ma Tei hospital in the early hours of Sunday; no injuries were reported.

zh.headline: 廣華醫院病人點燃約束帶及床墊 25歲男子涉縱火被捕
zh.dek: 周日凌晨油麻地廣華醫院發生可疑火警，一名25歲姓黃男病人涉嫌點燃約束帶及床墊，無人受傷，已被警方拘捕。

en.headline: Very Hot Weather and Thunderstorm Warnings in force this afternoon
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory issued the Very Hot Weather Warning at 1:10 p.m. and a Thunderstorm Warning at 2 p.m., valid until 4 p.m., expecting isolated thunderstorms over Lantau and the New Territories.

zh.headline: 酷熱天氣警告及雷暴警告生效 預料大嶼山新界局部有雷暴
zh.dek: 天文台下午1時10分發出酷熱天氣警告，下午2時發出雷暴警告至4時，預料大嶼山及新界有局部雷暴。

en.headline: Work-week outlook: unsettled with showers and possible tropical cyclone signals
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory expects cloudy conditions with occasional showers and squally thunderstorms early to midweek as Tropical Storm Narra edges closer to western Guangdong, with very hot weather returning later…

zh.headline: 下周展望：初中期不穩定有驟雨 或發熱帶氣旋警告
zh.dek: 天文台預料受廣闊低壓槽及熱帶風暴紫檀影響，下周初至中期多雲有驟雨及狂風雷暴，風勢較大，稍後轉酷熱。

en.headline: ERB to launch AI courses for working people from November
en.dek: Financial Secretary Paul Chan said the Employees Retraining Board will partner with major technology firms to offer specialised artificial-intelligence training as part of a HK$50 million two-year programme aiming to…

zh.headline: 陳茂波：僱員再培訓局11月起為在職人士推出AI課程
zh.dek: 財政司司長在網誌表示，再培訓局將與大型科企合作推出專業人工智能課程，屬五千萬元「全民AI培訓」計劃一部分，兩年目標惠及約五萬人次。

en.headline: Wang Fuk Court buy-back deadline will not be extended, official says
en.dek: Deputy Financial Secretary Michael Wong confirmed nearly 95 per cent of owners have accepted the government offer, with the August 31 cutoff remaining firm and later statutory compensation expected to be substantially…

zh.headline: 黃偉綸：宏福苑收購限期8月31日不延期 近95%業主已接受
zh.dek: 財政司副司長表示截至上周五94.7%業主已簽署接受收購建議，餘約100戶，重申期限嚴肅，稍後法定收樓補償將明顯較低。

en.headline: Taxi driver dies after being hit while checking tyre in Tseung Kwan O
en.dek: A 67-year-old taxi driver was killed early Sunday when a private car struck him from behind as he inspected a burst tyre on Wan Po Road near Hong Kong Velodrome Park.

zh.headline: 將軍澳的士司機落車查爆胎遭撞斃 私家車男司機涉危駕被捕
zh.dek: 周日凌晨一名67歲的士司機在環保大道因左後胎爆裂落車檢查時，被一輛私家車從後撞倒夾困，送院後不治，35歲私家車司機涉危險駕駛引致他人死亡被捕。

en.headline: Japanese lifestyle retailer LOFT returns to Hong Kong with one-year pop-up at MOKO
en.dek: After a 15-year absence the stationery and novelty specialist opened on Saturday at Mong Kok’s New Century Plaza, stocking about 3,500 products of which half are exclusive to the local market.

zh.headline: 日本生活雜貨店LOFT闊別15年重返香港 旺角MOKO設一年限定店
zh.dek: 文具及創意雜貨品牌周六於旺角新世紀廣場開業，店內約3,500款產品中有半數為香港限定，由引入3COINS的YAICHI集團營運。

en.headline: Local ice-cream brand TEEMTONEfai opens first permanent shop in Sheung Wan
en.dek: After a decade of pop-ups, the Hong Kong maker known for inventive flavours has settled at Upper Lascar Row with nine new Chinese-inspired scoops and soft-opening promotions through the end of August.

zh.headline: 本地雪糕品牌TEEMTONEfai上環開首間實體店
zh.dek: 成立十年後，以創意口味聞名的香港雪糕品牌終於在上環摩羅上街落腳，推出九款中式靈感新口味，試業優惠至八月底。

en.headline: Para Site’s 8th International Conference explores speculative tech futures at HKU today
en.dek: The free full-day event titled “Unsubscribe All!” runs from 10:30 a.m. to 6 p.m. at Wang Gungwu Lecture Hall, bringing together artists and thinkers from Hong Kong and abroad.

zh.headline: Para Site第八屆國際研討會今於港大探討科技推想未來
zh.dek: 名為「更新預設」的全日免費活動於上午10時半至下午6時在港大研究生堂王賡武講堂舉行，匯聚本地及海外藝術家與思想家。

en.headline: Peppa Pig’s Fun Day Out ends its Hong Kong debut today at East Kowloon Cultural Centre
en.dek: The interactive English-language musical, making its local premiere this weekend, stages its final performances on Sunday with shows at 11 am, 3 pm and 6 pm.

zh.headline: Peppa Pig音樂舞台劇香港首演今最後一日 東九文化中心上演
zh.dek: 互動英語音樂舞台劇《PEPPA PIG Fun Day Out!》周末於牛頭角東九文化中心首演，今日（23日）為最後一天，設上午11時、下午3時及6時三場。

en.headline: eHealth registration reaches 87 per cent of Hong Kong population
en.dek: Secretary for Health Lo Chung-mau said more than 6.5 million residents have joined the electronic health system as it marks its tenth anniversary.

zh.headline: 醫健通登記人數突破650萬 佔全港人口87%
zh.dek: 醫務衞生局局長盧寵茂在十周年活動上表示，系統已連結逾4700間醫護機構及6.3萬名醫護人員。

en.headline: Police arrest two men over phishing texts that netted more than HK$500,000
en.dek: Officers found 110 SIM cards and a modem pool in a hotel room used to send nearly 2,000 scam messages about undelivered parcels and insurance fees.

zh.headline: 警拘兩男涉發釣魚短訊騙逾50萬 檢110張電話卡
zh.dek: 商罪科在酒店房檢獲「貓池」裝置及近2000條已發短訊，兩名內地男子涉嫌串謀詐騙被捕。

en.headline: Driver arrested for drug driving after three-vehicle crash in Pok Fu Lam
en.dek: A refrigerated-truck driver tested positive for cocaine after a collision that left a light-goods-vehicle couple trapped and injured on Saturday afternoon.

zh.headline: 薄扶林道三車相撞 冷凍貨車司機涉毒駕被捕
zh.dek: 周六下午薄扶林道近置富花園發生三車相撞，客貨車一對夫婦被困受傷，冷凍貨車司機對可卡因呈陽性反應被捕。

en.headline: Worker injured after scaffolding collapses in Sham Shui Po
en.dek: A 69-year-old man was trapped under debris when a section of bamboo scaffolding fell from a building on Nam Cheong Street and was later rescued conscious.

zh.headline: 深水埗南昌街棚架倒塌 69歲男工受傷被困獲救
zh.dek: 周六下午南昌街近汝州街唐樓外牆棚架倒塌，一名69歲男工被困瓦礫下，消防救出後清醒送院。

en.headline: Thunderstorm Warning issued for New Territories, extended into evening
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory issued the warning at 5:52 p.m. and later extended it, expecting isolated thunderstorms over the New Territories.

zh.headline: 天文台發出雷暴警告至晚間 預料新界局部有雷暴
zh.dek: 天文台下午5時52分發出雷暴警告，其後延長有效時間，預料新界有局部地區雷暴。

en.headline: Hong Kong to send more than 500 athletes to Nagoya Asian Games
en.dek: Culture, Sports and Tourism Secretary Rosanna Law said full funding is being provided for the Games and the final squad will be confirmed at the September flag presentation.

zh.headline: 港隊亞運派出逾500人 羅淑佩指政府全額資助
zh.dek: 文化體育及旅遊局長表示運動員準備充足，正式名單下月初於授旗儀式公布，賽事9月19日開幕。

en.headline: Public hospital fee reform lifts full-waiver beneficiaries more than 20-fold
en.dek: Secretary for Health Lo Chung-mau said government subsidy remains at 95 per cent after the January changes, with a five-year target of 90 per cent, while 17 new drugs have been added to the formulary.

zh.headline: 公院收費改革後全額豁免人數增逾20倍 政府仍資助95%
zh.dek: 醫務衞生局局長盧寵茂表示，改革後政府資助維持95%，五年目標降至90%，藥物名冊已新增17種藥包括專科用藥。

en.headline: 10,000 civil servants take part in Huanggang port stress test
en.dek: The third major readiness exercise at the new Hong Kong Port Area tests full boundary clearance procedures, e-channels and vehicle booths ahead of the facility’s opening.

zh.headline: 皇崗口岸港方區周六壓力測試 萬名公務員參與
zh.dek: 新皇崗口岸港方口岸區第三場大型演練測試全面通關流程、電子通道及車輛檢查亭，為口岸啟用作準備。

en.headline: Ukrainian Culture Day brings bazaar, workshops and music to Goethe-Institut
en.dek: The one-day event on Saturday features a free handicraft bazaar, embroidery exhibitions, workshops, Ukrainian food and two live music performances in Wan Chai.

zh.headline: 烏克蘭文化日歌德學院舉行 設市集工作坊及音樂會
zh.dek: 香港烏克蘭協會周六於灣仔歌德學院舉辦一日活動，包括免費手工藝市集、刺繡展覽、工作坊、美食及兩場現場音樂演出。

en.headline: Tourism chief confident Hong Kong will hit 53.8 million visitor target
en.dek: Rosanna Law said the first seven months delivered solid growth despite July rain and higher fuel costs, with the traditional peak season still ahead.

zh.headline: 羅淑佩有信心全年達5380萬人次訪港目標
zh.dek: 文化體育及旅遊局局長指首七個月已錄得約3122萬人次，即使7月多雨及燃油成本上升，仍對下半年旺季有信心。

en.headline: Multiple collisions on North Lantau Highway disrupt airport traffic
en.dek: Ten accidents involving 29 vehicles left five people injured this morning near Siu Ho Wan, with temporary lane closures towards the airport.

zh.headline: 北大嶼山公路多宗車禍 往機場方向一度封閉部分行車線
zh.dek: 今早約兩小時內發生十宗交通意外，涉29輛車，其中三宗造成五人輕傷，運輸署曾封閉近小蠔灣部分行車線並呼籲市民乘搭港鐵。
